Key Capabilities

Explore how EnvirOptimus empowers organizations across industries to enhance operational efficiency, safeguard people and assets, and advance sustainability goals. From intelligent air quality management and hazardous gas monitoring to smart HVAC and compressor control, our integrated solutions deliver actionable insights and automated responses, building safer and more resilient facilities.
Air Quality Monitoring (IAQ & AQI)
  • Real-time CO₂-based DCV for fresh air adjustment & energy savings
  • AQI sensors for clean rooms in pharma/electronics
  • Gas detection to auto-vent harmful gases & protect workers
  • BMS integration & special uses (breweries, large spaces, ISO 14001 support)
Track and control indoor air quality for healthier, compliant spaces
Hazardous Gas Monitoring
  • SO₂, NOx, VOC monitoring in chemical plants
  • Leak detection in tubing, valves & machinery
  • CO₂ control in breweries, bottling lines & cold storage
  • Byproduct detection in pharma units for worker safety
Prevent toxic leaks and ensure compliance across industries
Sustainability & Compliance Automation
  • Automated tracking of energy, emissions & IAQ KPIs for ESG reporting
  • Supports certification goals like LEED, WELL, IGBC & ISO 50001
  • Smart alerts for deviation from sustainability benchmarks
  • Digital documentation for audits & regulatory compliance
Simplify sustainability compliance with automated tracking
Boiler Optimization & Temperature Monitoring
  • Temperature alerts for equipment protection
  • Boiler heat loss tracking (dry flue gases, radiation, fuel moisture)
  • Combustion fine-tuning to improve efficiency
  • Fuel cost reduction through optimized performance
Keep Equipment Efficient and Safe
Occupancy Monitoring for Smart HVAC
  • Healthcare & commercial HVAC adapts to occupancy
  • Sensors regulate airflow & temperature dynamically
  • Dashboards show zone-wise occupancy rates
  • Targeted optimization for reduced waste & better comfort
Smarter comfort, lower waste
Compressor Management for HVAC
  • Dynamic loading: auto-adjust from small to large compressors
  • Predictive maintenance via auto-switching for balanced wear
  • Load-based scheduling reduces Scope 2 emissions
  • Live benchmarking (real-time kW/CFM analysis) for efficiency
Reduce costs and emissions with load-based scheduling
Advanced HVAC Controls & Pump Efficiency
  • CO₂-based ventilation for energy & comfort balance
  • Chilled/cooling water optimization with auto-shut valves
  • Real-time monitoring of flow, temp, and pressure
  • Automated alerts for quick KPI deviation response
Boost system efficiency while cutting kW/TR
